/* Tenure */  Diane Harkey was elected to California's State Board of Equalization, representing 4 counties in Southern California, Orange, Riverside San Diego and Imperial.  She served honorable for 4 years at which time she was elected unanimously by her peers to become the first Republican Chair of the Board in 15 years. No action was ever taken after a lengthy investigation of published newspaper accusations during her tenure .
